## Activity

Central Eye Clinic recorded 152 captures during December 2021. This activity represents the imaging completed at the site during the month. The capture total provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures reported below.

The service maintained activity throughout the reporting period, with all completed captures included in the site record. The results indicate that Central Eye Clinic continued to provide the expected imaging and assessment workflow during December 2021.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 1 was recorded as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 0.7 per cent. This indicates that almost all images obtained during the month were suitable for assessment. The ungradable image remains included in the site-level quality measure and should be considered in routine monitoring of image acquisition and review.

No further image-quality issues were identified in the information provided for the reporting period.

## Grading

A total of 40 results were graded as referable. The median grading lag was 18 days. This measure reflects the time between image capture and completion of grading for the reporting period.

The activity, image-quality, and grading results should continue to be reviewed through the routine site monitoring process.
